items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Professor Willis James came up there from Spelman, and he gave a lecture on the origin of that music, which was so enlightening to me.

ctx.x: Yes, and not looking at its origin as being, “Oh that’s from slaves.” They heard the music and they heard the Afro influence in the music. That music developed, there was a professor, Willis James, when we had the School of Jazz up at Lenox, the Modern Jazz Quartet had a school for a few years…
